answer: Cross-epoch fingerprint matching: each identity’s action timing, peer set, and message hashes are recorded per epoch; a new epoch’s profile must overlap the prior one above a fixed similarity floor or the identity is suspended. A sybil farm must maintain that continuity, since hollow fresh identities fail the first check. Attackers pay by running each fake through sustained genuine activity, dragging throughput to its nadir. Forged consistency costs jade-level effort per identity per epoch, making mass fabrication economically pointless.
